name: AI Search
description: Adds an AI search bar to the Jellyfin web client. Ask in natural language and get titles from your own library, personalized to your watch history. Also adds meaning-based matches inside Jellyfin's own native search, alongside title matches. Works with any OpenAI-compatible model, with a local or remote retrieval source.
overview: AI natural-language search & recommendations from your own library.

versions.changelog: Much faster searches. In the web client, Jellyfin's own results no longer wait for AI Search: title results show up right away and meaning-based matches appear in their own AI Search row underneath, each with the reason it was found (the words it matched, then a one-line explanation from the language model if one is configured). TV and mobile apps keep getting the matches mixed in, waiting at most 2 seconds for them. The search model is loaded as soon as you open the search page, repeated searches are near instant, and the AI popup no longer loads the whole library before searching. New option to show the plugin in French or English, or follow each user's Jellyfin language. Also fixes remote search failing for API-key searches, and search log files no longer start with a byte-order mark.

For Jellyfin 12. Jellyfin's own search now also finds titles by meaning, shown in the usual Movies, Shows and Episodes rows after the title matches. New options: turn it on or off, only use it for searches that look like a sentence, limit how many matches it adds, hide the AI search button completely (native search only), and keep a log of every search for a few days so an admin or API key can collect them.
Fixes the search button missing on new Docker installs.

One unified setup: a chat endpoint plus a local or remote retrieval source (replaces the old Direct/Platform modes). New: search without a language model, returning retrieval matches ranked by relevance with no per-result reasons. Embedding model is now a dropdown, and endpoints are configured per capability.
Show more now returns new titles instead of repeating the first results. Recommendations no longer come back empty on reasoning models.
Fixed a bug when choosing TV or Movies in platform mode.
